parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: project = "YOUR_PROJECT_KEY" AND (created >= -7d OR resolutiondate >= -7d OR resolution = Unresolved)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-5-5', max_tokens: 400, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: "You are a delivery-management analyst. Write a weekly status note of max 120 words for a program steering group from the JSON counts below. Structure: 1 headline sentence, 3 bullets (flow, backlog risk, aging), 1 recommended action. Use only the numbers provided; do not invent causes. If net_flow is positive, say the backlog is growing." + '\n\n' + JSON.stringify($json.stats) }] }) }}

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Weekly delivery status – ' + $now.toFormat('dd LLL yyyy') }}
